questions.question: What was Daniel doing before the vision of chapter 10?
options: Feasting and rejoicing for many days
Mourning and fasting for three weeks
Marching with the army into battle
Building an altar by the great river
questions.answer: Mourning and fasting for three weeks

questions.question: What heavenly being is mentioned as helping against the 'prince of Persia'?
options: Gabriel, the chief messenger of God
Michael, one of the chief princes
questions.answer: Michael, one of the chief princes

questions.question: The man in the vision told Daniel he was greatly loved and should not fear.
The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood the messenger for _____ days.
O man greatly loved, fear not, _____ be with you; be strong and of good courage.
